description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.

Cost: Half (Round Up) the original weapon’s Cost ♦ Availability: Price Category is unchanged

“We live in dangerous times. Violence is rampant, so everyone needs a way to defend themselves. Sadly, many can’t afford effective problem-solvers, which is where bootlegs come to save the day. Yeah, customizing ‘em is a pain and they fall apart easier, but look at that price tag!”

An Ironfake Variant Weapon becomes Exotic if it was not already so, is reduced to Poor Quality, and all of its BODY requirements (if any) are increased by 1 (e.g., BODY 10+ to not jam is now BODY 11+ to not jam). If the weapon was already Poor Quality, its Ironfake Variant now jams when rolling any 1 during the Attack Check (i.e., not negated by Fumble Recovery) and when it malfunctions, it requires an additional Action to clear the malfunction. An Ironfake Weapon cannot be bought using the CEMK’s rule of purchasing it at double its Cost to source it without a Fixer.

Exotic Poor Quality Very Heavy Pistol. Armor-Piercing Ammunition bought for this weapon costs 10eb (Everyday) per 10, and can only be used by this weapon (Which is capable of loading Armor-Piecing Ammunition despite being Exotic).

Variant of: Arasaka Tamayura
Class: Exotic Poor Quality Very Heavy Pistol
Range: Pistol
